<article id="post-89" class="post-89 page type-page status-publish hentry entry">

			<header class="entry-header alignwide">
			<h1 class="entry-title">Complaints</h1>					</header><!-- .entry-header -->
	
	<div class="entry-content">
		<p>APJ CERT shall be responsible for all decisions at all levels of the complaints handling process. Submission, investigation and decision on complaints shall not result in any discriminatory actions against the complaint. Upon receipt of a complaint, the APJ CERT shall confirm whether the complaint relates to the auditing activities that it is responsible for and, if so, shall deal with it.</p>
<p>If the complaint relates to an audited client, then examination of the complaint shall consider the effectiveness of the audited management system.<br />
Any valid complaint about an audited client shall also be referred by APJ CERT to the audited client in question at an appropriate time</p>
<p>APJ CERT have a documented process to receive, evaluate and make decisions on complaints. This process shall be subject to requirements for confidentiality, as it relates to the complainant and to the subject of the complaint</p>
<p>The complaint handling process shall include at least the following elements and methods</p>
<ol>
<li>An outline of the process for receiving, validating, investigating the complaint, and for deciding what actions need to be taken in response to it</li>
<li>Tracking and recording complaints, including actions undertaken in response to them</li>
<li>Ensuring that any appropriate correction and corrective action are taken</li>
</ol>
<p>APJ CERT shall be responsible for gathering and verifying all necessary information to validate the complaint. Whenever possible, APJ CERT shall acknowledge receipt of the complaint and shall provide the complaint with progress reports and the result of the complaint.</p>
<p>The decision to be communicated to the complainant shall be made by or reviewed and approved by, individual (s) not previously involved in the subject of the complaint. Whenever possible, the APJ CERT shall give formal notice of the end of the complaints-handling process to the complainant.</p>
<p>APJ CERT shall determine, together with the audited client and the complainant, whether and, if so to what extent, the subject of the complaint and its resolution shall be made public.</p>
	</div><!-- .entry-content -->

	</article><!-- #post-89 -->

	<div class="entry-content">
		<h4><strong><span style="color: #ff6600;">SAFETY & HEALTH MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS AUDITS (CONSASS)</span></strong></h4>
<p>As per Regulation 9 of WORKPLACE SAFETY AND HEALTH (SAFETY AND HEALTH MANAGEMENT SYSTEM AND AUDITING) REGULATIONS 2009, it shall be the duty of the occupier of construction worksite to appoint a workplace safety and health auditor to audit the safety and health management system of the workplace at a frequency as specified below.</p>
<p>Any worksite with a contract sum of $30 million or moreAt least once every 6 months</p>
<p>The audit methodology includes document review, site inspection and interview of key personnel. The man days required for audits will vary according to audit criteria adopted for different types of workplaces.</p>
<p>The SHMS audit will be conducted in accordance with the relevant WSH legislation and guidelines set out for each industry. The audit will evaluate the SHMS based on the WSH Act and its subsidiary legislation, as well as the following documents:</p>
<p>Construction WorksitesConstruction Safety Audit Scoring System (ConSASS) Requirements</p>
<p>The audit will be conducted by WSH Auditors employed by Reliance Certification Pte Ltd (SAC accredited auditing organization)</p>
<p>The Construction Safety Audit Scoring System (ConSASS) is an audit tool which provides an independent assessment of the safety and health management system at a worksite.</p>
<p>ConSASS provides a profile of the development status and maturity level of each component of a worksite’s safety and health management system. This helps management to better allocate resources in order to elevate standard and improve the effectiveness in managing a worksite’s safety and health risks. As an assessment tool, ConSASS can be used for cross-comparison between worksites in relation to their effectiveness in managing workplace safety and health risks.</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #ff0000;">AUDIT OBJECTIVES:</span></strong></p>
<p>Unified assessment method in term of standardisation of audit checklist and adoption of a common audit scoring system. This would enhance the consistency in the auditing process and allow cross comparison of worksites in terms of the capabilities in managing safety and health risk.<br />
Mechanism to profile the maturity level for each element of the SHMS in a worksite. With availability of the maturity profile, the management of the worksite could systematically focus its attention to improve the weaker elements in order to elevate the overall maturity of their SHMS to manage safety and health risk.<br />
Determine whether Project’s WSH Management System, or parts of it, conforms to audit criteria;<br />
Determine the ability of the Project’s WSH Management System to ensure the organization meets applicable statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements<br />
Determination of the effectiveness of the WSH Management System to ensure the project can reasonably expect to achieving its specified objectives<br />
As applicable, identification of areas for potential improvement of the WSH Management System.</p>
<p><span style="color: #ff6600;"><strong>AUDIT CRITERIA:</strong></span><br />
ConSASS Checklist & Guidelines from Ministry of Manpower (MOM) & WSH Council</p>
<p><span style="color: #ff6600;"><strong>NORMATIVE REFERENCES:</strong></span></p>
<p>1.WSH Act<br />
2.Relevant WSH Subsidiary Legislations<br />
3.WSH (Safety & Health Management Systems and Auditing) Regulations 2009<br />
4.Fire Safety (Petroleum & Flammable Materials) (Amendment) Regulations 2015<br />
5.Relevant Approved Singapore Standards and Codes of Practices<br />
6.SAC Terms and Conditions for Auditing Organizations<br />
7.Safety & Health Management Systems Manual for above Project<br />
8.Safety & Health Procedures for above Project<br />
9.ConSASS Audit Checklist Questionnaire<br />
10.ConSASS Audit Guidelines from WSH Council<br />
11.Appendix 1A Factsheet of ConSASS<br />
12.CT 17 SAC Criteria for Accreditation of Auditing Organisations</p>
<p><span style="color: #ff6600;"><strong>AUDIT SCOPE:</strong></span></p>
<p>Audit Scope covers all the work activities at the above project based on current scope of activity at site.</p>
<p><span style="color: #ff6600;"><strong>AUDIT METHODOLOGY:</strong></span></p>
<p>Audit Preparation;<br />
Conducting the opening meeting;<br />
Familiarization Tour of Project Site.<br />
Communicating during the audit;<br />
Collecting and verifying information;<br />
Review of Documents / Records<br />
Physical Inspection of Project Site<br />
Interview of Key Personnel<br />
Generating audit findings;<br />
Preparing audit conclusions;<br />
Conducting the closing meeting;<br />
Preparation and Submission of Audit report</p>
<p><span style="color: #ff6600;"><strong>ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF AUDIT TEAM:</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="color: #808080;"><strong>Lead Auditor:</strong></span></p>
<p>Lead the audit team.<br />
Conduct opening meeting covering all relevant items as per auditing standard.<br />
Review the results of previous audits, if any.<br />
Ensure that audits are carried out according to requirements stipulated by Regulatory Authorities.<br />
Assign the tasks to audit team.<br />
Keep the client informed of audit progress.<br />
Reassign work as needed between the audit team members and periodically communicate the progress of the audit and any concerns to the client<br />
Where the available audit evidence indicates that the audit objectives are unattainable or suggests the presence of an immediate and significant risk (e.g. Safety), the audit team leader shall report this to the client.<br />
Review with the client any need for changes to the audit scope that becomes apparent as on-site auditing activities progress.<br />
Attempt to resolve any diverging opinions between the audit team and the client concerning audit evidence or findings, and record unresolved points.<br />
Review audit findings with his team.<br />
Conduct closing meeting covering all relevant items as per auditing standard.<br />
Present audit conclusions during closing meeting.<br />
Consolidate the audit report and send to Reliance Certification Pte Ltd</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #808080;">Co-Auditor:</span></strong></p>
<p>Conduct audits according to requirements from Regulatory Authorities.<br />
Carry out audits as per audit itinerary.<br />
Discuss audit findings with lead auditor prior to closing meeting.<br />
Follow the directions given by lead auditor.<br />
Assist the lead auditor in presenting findings on clauses / elements audited by him during closing meeting.<br />
Prepare and submit to lead auditor with report on clauses / elements audited by him.</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #808080;">Auditee(s) / Guide:</span></strong></p>
<p>Establishing contacts and timing for interviews;<br />
Arranging visits to specific parts of the site or organization;<br />
Ensuring that rules concerning site safety and security procedures are known and respected by the audit team members;<br />
Witnessing the audit on behalf of the client;<br />
Providing clarification or information as requested by an auditor.</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #808080;">Technical Experts:</span></strong></p>
<p>Technical Experts will be deployed as necessary for audits.</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #808080;">Testimony of Audit Conducted:</span></strong></p>
<p>If client request , Testimony will be issued</p>
<p>A testimony will be issued to the audited organization stating the company name, location, audit criteria, audit date and auditing organization name.</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: #808080;">Processes for handling requests for information and complaints:</span></strong></p>
<p>If audited client has any request for information and complaints, he can email to  admin@apjcert.com stating clearly client name, identity & contact details of person making the request and details of complaints.</p>

			<header class="entry-header alignwide">
			<h1 class="entry-title">Impartiality Policy</h1>					</header><!-- .entry-header -->
	
	<div class="entry-content">
		
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">It is the policy of APJ to operate its business in accordance with the guidance principles of impartiality, competence, responsibility, openness, confidentiality and responsiveness. APJviews the safeguarding of impartiality as paramount in maintaining confidence in DS audit services. AIPL senior management has established and promoted an impartiality policy with associated objectives on which APJ service will be based. APJ’s management is committed for managing conflict of interest, in case there is any, and brings objectivity to the audit process.</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span lang="EN-SG"> </span><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">A relationship that threatens APJ’s impartiality can be based upon ownership, governance, personnel, shared resources, finances, contracts, marketing and payment of a sales commission or other inducement for the referral of new clients etc. APJ’s top management is committed to impartiality in its management system audit services. All Director , staff and sub-contractors are required to complete and sign the Compliance with Conflict of Interest Form.</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span lang="EN-SG"> </span><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">In order to remain impartial APJ always strives to;</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span lang="EN-SG"> </span><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Constantly educate and make all staff members aware of all possible threats of conflict of interest that can arise during verification</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Continuously monitor and identify possible threats to our impartiality and guard against such threats</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Report such threats to authorities responsible for taking further actions, both internally and externally</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Ensure that all management and staff are aware of the confidentiality agreement APJ has with the clients</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Empower management staff to take immediate actions against any staff or client who act in a way that undermines APJ’s position on impartiality</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Demand that all staff declare any relationship that they may have which can result in breaching the conduct on impartiality and or confidentiality with clients or business partners</span></span></p>
<p class="selectable-text"><span class="selectable-text1"><span lang="EN-SG">Constantly provide APJ staff with necessary support in reporting and cooperating with authorities when reporting incident(s) which are threats to APJ’s impartiality</span></span></p>
	</div><!-- .entry-content -->

	<div class="entry-content">
		<p><span style="color: #3366ff;"><strong>APJ CERTIFICATION </strong></span>is a Auditing, Internal and External Training company based in Singapore established by D.Prabhu With more than 15 years of experience, we are dedicated to provide Workplace Safety & Health, Environmental and Audit services to various industries.</p>
<p>APJ’s  Auditors are highly qualified as WSH professionals; each having Bachelor degree in the field of engineering, safety and health; specialist diplomas in occupational safety and health through recognized educational institutions.</p>
	</div><!-- .entry-content -->

<h5><strong><span style="color: #000000;">Our Vision</span></strong></h5>
<p><img decoding="async" class="alignnone  wp-image-269 alignleft" src="/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/vision1.png" alt="" width="148" height="148" srcset="/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/vision1.png 200w, /wp-content/uploads/2023/01/vision1-150x150.png 150w" sizes="(max-width: 148px) 100vw, 148px" /> APJ CERT vision is to be a professional organization in the field of auditing services and creating values for customers. APJ CERT cherishes the values of professionalism, teamwork, integrity, fairness and improvement through knowledge with continuous learning.</p>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>
<h5><strong><span style="color: #000000;">OUR MISSION</span></strong></h5>
<p><img decoding="async" loading="lazy" class="alignnone  wp-image-265 alignleft" src="/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/mission1.png" alt="" width="164" height="164" srcset="/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/mission1.png 200w, /wp-content/uploads/2023/01/mission1-150x150.png 150w" sizes="(max-width: 164px) 100vw, 164px" />APJ CERT mission is to build and sustain a position of leadership by providing safety and health management system auditing services within to Singapore markets in all Industries.</p>
<p> </p>
<p style="text-align: left;"> </p>
<h5><strong><span style="color: #000000;">OUR VALUES</span></strong></h5>
<p><img decoding="async" loading="lazy" class="alignnone  wp-image-270 alignleft" src="/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/values1.png" alt="" width="141" height="141" srcset="/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/values1.png 200w, /wp-content/uploads/2023/01/values1-150x150.png 150w" sizes="(max-width: 141px) 100vw, 141px" />APJ CERT cherishes and upholds the following values:<br />• Enthusiasm to excel<br />• Teamwork <br />• Openness <br />• Integrity and fairness in all matters<br />• Social and environmental responsibility<br />• Improvement through knowledge and continuous learning</p>

			<h1 class="entry-title">Risk Management Audit</h1>					</header><!-- .entry-header -->
	
	<div class="entry-content">
		<p>The objective of Risk Management Audit is to assess organization’s compliance with WSH (Risk Management) Regulations and bizSAFE Level 3 Requirements.</p>
<p>This audit is applicable to those organizations who are going for bizSAFE Level 3 and bizSAFE STAR recognition.</p>
<p>The SHMS audit will be conducted in accordance with the relevant WSH legislation and guidelines set out for each industry. The audit will evaluate the SHMS based on the WSH Act and its subsidiary legislation, as well as the following documents:</p>
<p>The Audit will be conducted by WSH Auditors employed by SAC Accredited Auditing Organization. The audit covers document review, site inspection on verifying implementation of risk control measures and interview of key personnel. Documents such as training certificates, OHS Policy, risk assessment procedure, risk assessment report, safe work procedure and related communication records will be checked during the audit.</p>
